title: Clean Harbors CEO Appears on "Mad Money" with Jim Cramer
summary: Clean Harbors CEO, Alan McKim, appeared on CNBC's stock show "Mad Money" where he talked with host Jim Cramer
body_markdown:
Clean Harbors CEO Alan McKim appeared on CNBC's stock show "Mad Money" where he talked with host Jim Cramer about the oil market and the record amounts of hazardous waste Clean Harbors is collecting.


[See the full clip here](https://www.cnbc.com/video/2018/09/04/clean-harbors-ceo-were-collecting-record-amounts-of-hazardous-waste.html)
